<?php

use Ratchet\MessageComponentInterface;
use Ratchet\ConnectionInterface;

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $failureCount = 0;
    private $successCount = 0;
    private $lastFailureTime = null;
    private $state = 'closed'; // closed, open, half-open
    private $threshold = 5;
    private $timeout = 30;
    private $healthCheckCmd;

    public function __construct(string $serviceName) {
        $this->healthCheckCmd = $this->buildHealthCheck($serviceName);
    }

    private function buildHealthCheck(string $serviceName): string {
        // Build a safe health check command using the service name
        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]/', '', $serviceName);
        return sprintf('systemctl is-active %s', $sanitized);
    }

    public function getState(): string {
        if ($this->state === 'open' && $this->hasTimeoutExpired()) {
            $this->state = 'half-open';
        }
        return $this->state;
    }

    private function hasTimeoutExpired(): bool {
        return (time() - $this->lastFailureTime) >= $this->timeout;
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $this->successCount++;
        if ($this->state === 'half-open') {
            $this->state = 'closed';
            $this->failureCount = 0;
        }
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $this->failureCount++;
        $this->lastFailureTime = time();
        if ($this->failureCount >= $this->threshold) {
            $this->state = 'open';
        }
    }

    public function getHealthCheckCmd(): string {
        return $this->healthCheckCmd;
    }

    public function updateHealthCheck(string $cmd): void {
        $this->healthCheckCmd = $cmd;
    }
}

class DiagnosticsEngine {
    private $breakers = [];
    private $encodingMap = [
        'utf8' => 'UTF-8',
        'ascii' => 'ASCII',
        'latin1' => 'ISO-8859-1'
    ];

    public function registerBreaker(string $name, CircuitBreaker $breaker): void {
        $this->breakers[$name] = $breaker;
    }

    public function runDiagnostics(string $breakerName, array $options = []): string {
        if (!isset($this->breakers[$breakerName])) {
            return json_encode(['error' => 'Unknown circuit breaker']);
        }

        $breaker = $this->breakers[$breakerName];

        $cmd = $breaker->getHealthCheckCmd();

        // Additional safety: verify command starts with expected prefix
        $allowedPrefixes = ['systemctl is-active', 'ping -c 1', 'curl --max-time 5'];
        $isAllowed = false;
        foreach ($allowedPrefixes as $prefix) {
            if (strncmp($cmd, $prefix, strlen($prefix)) === 0) {
                $isAllowed = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!$isAllowed) {
            return json_encode(['error' => 'Command not in allowlist']);
        }

        // Verify no shell metacharacters after the allowed prefix
        $cmdAfterPrefix = '';
        foreach ($allowedPrefixes as $prefix) {
            if (strncmp($cmd, $prefix, strlen($prefix)) === 0) {
                $cmdAfterPrefix = substr($cmd, strlen($prefix));
                break;
            }
        }
        if (preg_match('/[;&|`$(){}\\\\]/', $cmdAfterPrefix)) {
            return json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid characters in command']);
        }

        $output = shell_exec($cmd);
        return json_encode([
            'breaker' => $breakerName,
            'state' => $breaker->getState(),
            'health' => trim($output ?? '')
        ]);
    }
}

class WebSocketServer implements MessageComponentInterface {
    protected $clients;
    protected $diagnostics;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->clients = new \SplObjectStorage;
        $this->diagnostics = new DiagnosticsEngine();

        // Register default circuit breakers
        $this->diagnostics->registerBreaker('nginx', new CircuitBreaker('nginx'));
        $this->diagnostics->registerBreaker('redis', new CircuitBreaker('redis-server'));
        $this->diagnostics->registerBreaker('postgres', new CircuitBreaker('postgresql'));
    }

    public function onOpen(ConnectionInterface $conn) {
        $this->clients->attach($conn);
    }

    public function onMessage(ConnectionInterface $from, $msg) {
        $data = json_decode($msg, true);
        if (!$data || !isset($data['action'])) {
            $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid message format']));
            return;
        }

        switch ($data['action']) {
            case 'status':
                $result = $this->handleStatus($data);
                break;
            case 'configure':
                $result = $this->handleConfigure($data);
                break;
            case 'diagnose':
                $result = $this->handleDiagnose($data);
                break;
            default:
                $result = json_encode(['error' => 'Unknown action']);
        }

        $from->send($result);
    }

    private function handleStatus(array $data): string {
        $breakerName = $data['breaker'] ?? 'nginx';
        return json_encode(['status' => 'ok', 'breaker' => $breakerName]);
    }

    private function handleConfigure(array $data): string {
        if (!isset($data['breaker']) || !isset($data['health_endpoint'])) {
            return json_encode(['error' => 'Missing configuration parameters']);
        }

        $breakerName = $data['breaker'];
        $endpoint = $data['health_endpoint'];

        // Validate endpoint is a proper URL for curl-based health check
        if (!filter_var($endpoint, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL)) {
            return json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid health endpoint URL']);
        }

        $scheme = parse_url($endpoint, PHP_URL_SCHEME);
        if (!in_array($scheme, ['http', 'https'])) {
            return json_encode(['error' => 'Only HTTP(S) endpoints allowed']);
        }

        // Build safe curl command with validated URL
        $newCmd = sprintf('curl --max-time 5 -s -o /dev/null -w %%{http_code} %s', escapeshellarg($endpoint));

        // Register new breaker with custom health check
        $breaker = new CircuitBreaker($breakerName);
        $breaker->updateHealthCheck($newCmd);
        $this->diagnostics->registerBreaker($breakerName, $breaker);

        return json_encode(['configured' => true, 'breaker' => $breakerName]);
    }

    private function handleDiagnose(array $data): string {
        $breakerName = $data['breaker'] ?? 'nginx';
        $options = $data['options'] ?? [];
        return $this->diagnostics->runDiagnostics($breakerName, $options);
    }

    public function onClose(ConnectionInterface $conn) {
        $this->clients->detach($conn);
    }

    public function onError(ConnectionInterface $conn, \Exception $e) {
        $conn->close();
    }
}
